items.title: TRUMP PRAISES STEPHEN MILLER, CALLS HIM “THE MOST POWERFUL MAN IN THE WORLD” | Garowe Online
items.author: GAROWE ONLINE, GO
items.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump stunned the White House briefing room on Friday, November 20, 2026, by publicly praising his new Chief of Staff, Stephen Miller. Trump invited Miller to the podium and described him as “the most powerful man in the world,” while making a comparison that placed him above Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The remarks came during a White House press briefing, drawing attention to Miller's growing influence within the Trump administration.
